facts.content: Patient complains of low appetite, low energy, episodic shortness of breath, palpitations, intermittent nausea, and headaches.
facts.source_text: CC: Low appetite, low energy; episodic SOB/palpitations esp. in lift; intermittent nausea; headaches

facts.content: Patient has low mood and anergia.
facts.source_text: Low mood, anergia; ↓ libido/“nightly activities” issues

facts.content: Patient reports decreased appetite for about 3 to 3.5 months and unintentional weight loss of approximately 1 stone over about 6 months.
facts.source_text: ↓ appetite ~3–3.5 mo; unintentional wt loss ~≈1 st over ~6 mo

facts.content: Patient experiences intermittent nausea but no vomiting.
facts.source_text: Nausea intermittently; no vomiting

facts.content: The patient has normal bowel movements with no diarrhea or blood/mucus.
facts.source_text: Bowels: no diarrhea, no blood/mucus; painless BMs

facts.content: Shortness of breath occurs in the lift with palpitations but not when walking.
facts.source_text: SOB: not on walking per pt; episodes in lift with palpitations; no chest pain

facts.content: Patient is a lawyer and can perform duties, occasionally gets headaches and nausea at work.
facts.source_text: Work: lawyer; can perform duties; occasional headaches/nausea at work

facts.content: Patient reports some strain at home related to appetite.
facts.source_text: Home: some strain related to appetite; otherwise OK

facts.content: Patient has a history of hypothyroidism.
facts.source_text: PMH: Hypothyroidism

facts.content: Patient previously took thyroxine but stopped about 3 months ago since changing doctor.
facts.source_text: Previously thyroxine; stopped since changing doctor (~3 mo)

facts.content: Patient is married and works as a lawyer.
facts.source_text: SH: Married; lawyer

facts.content: Patient has low mood and fatigue with decreased appetite and weight loss; need to rule out medical contributors like anemia, thyroid issues, or nutritional deficiencies.
facts.source_text: Low mood/fatigue with ↓ appetite and wt loss (~1 st/6 mo); r/o medical contributors (anemia, thyroid, nutritional deficiencies)

facts.content: Episodic palpitations and shortness of breath in the lift are consistent with anxiety or panic episodes, but cardiac etiology is less likely.
facts.source_text: Episodic palpitations/SOB in lift, non-exertional, no chest pain — c/w anxiety/panic episodes; cardiac etiology less likely but to monitor

facts.content: The patient has a history of hypothyroidism and stopped levothyroxine about 3 months ago; current thyroid status is unknown.
facts.source_text: Hypothyroidism — levothyroxine stopped ~3 mo; current thyroid status unknown

facts.content: Patient has intermittent nausea without vomiting and normal bowel movements.
facts.source_text: Intermittent nausea without vomiting; bowels normal

facts.content: Patient has experienced unintentional weight loss.
facts.source_text: Unintentional wt loss

facts.content: Arrange blood tests including FBC, U&E, LFTs, vitamin levels, and TFTs.
facts.source_text: Arrange bloods: FBC (anemia), U&E, LFTs, vitamin levels (e.g., B12/folate/Vit D per local panel), TFTs (TSH/FT4)

facts.content: Review results and consider in-person examination if blood tests are non-revealing.
facts.source_text: Review results and consider in-person exam if bloods non-revealing

facts.content: Safety net: Advise to go to A&E if chest pain, persistent palpitations, or worsening shortness of breath occurs.
facts.source_text: Safety-net: If chest pain, persistent palpitations, or worsening SOB → A&E

facts.content: Monitor frequency and triggers of palpitations and shortness of breath, reassess after labs.
facts.source_text: Monitor frequency/triggers; reassess after labs

facts.content: Monitor symptoms of nausea and report new vomiting or changes in bowel habits.
facts.source_text: Monitor symptoms; report new vomiting or bowel habit change

facts.content: Patient to call support via app to arrange blood draw, clinician to send form.
facts.source_text: Patient to call support via app to arrange blood draw; clinician to send form

facts.content: Results will be communicated via text prompting the patient to book a follow-up; earlier contact if there is deterioration.
facts.source_text: Results via text prompt to book follow-up; earlier contact if deterioration
